definitions: To cover the top or end of something with a cap or similar covering.
To put a limit on the amount, size, or extent of something.
To complete or finish something, often in a fitting or impressive way.
To provide a cap for a tooth.
To remove the top part of a mushroom or other fungus.
examples: The council capped the number of new houses.
His brilliant goal capped a fine performance.
The dentist capped her front tooth.
He carefully capped the wild mushrooms.
